transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I can’t get rid of this feeling that I’m being punished for letting my father decline. My sister shows me the doctor’s notes and tells me I did everything I could, but… it doesn’t change it. It feels like some judgment has already been passed on me.
Alongside these feelings, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless most days?
Yes. Most days I wake up feeling heavy and hollow, like all the color has gone out of things. I’ll be at my desk at work, or looking at the garden, and it just… none of it reaches me anymore.
Have you ever had a period of several days or more where you felt unusually energized, euphoric, or wired, needing much less sleep than usual?
I don’t think so. I can’t recall having a stretch where I felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this down or depressed before in your life?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had hard times before, but I can’t say whether they were like this.
Have you ever heard voices or other sounds that no one else seemed to hear?
Yes. When the house is quiet at night, I sometimes hear a woman’s voice, like she’s in the hallway, saying, “You failed him.” I’ve gotten up to check more than once, but there’s nobody there.
During any of those hard times in the past, did you ever seek professional help or take medication for depression?
I’m not sure. I don’t remember seeing anyone or taking anything for it before.
During any of those past hard times, did you ever have a stretch of two weeks or more where it was difficult to get out of bed or carry out your daily responsibilities?

Yes... I’ve missed deadlines at work and avoided employee meetings I would normally handle. I also stopped going to my library volunteer shifts because I can’t keep myself steady enough to follow through.
Before this current episode began, was there ever a separate time in your life when you went through a depression like this?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another separate time like this before now.
